text:
For charging a lot of AA and AAA NiMH cells at once, I'd go with a 16-bay charger that has independent slots. Prices weren't in most of the results, so check them before you buy.

**Best for bulk (16 bays)**
- **Tenergy TN438 16-Bay**: My top pick. It has an LCD showing each cell's status, takes any mix of AA/AAA NiMH/NiCd, and has overcharge, overheat, short-circuit and reverse-polarity protection plus an 8-hour timer. ([source](https://electronicsadvisor.org/best-nimh-battery-charger/))
- **BONAI 16-Bay**: Independent slots, so you can mix AA and AAA in any position. It runs on 110-240V AC at 250-500mA per port, with LED status per slot. It won't charge alkaline or lithium cells. ([source](https://electronicsadvisor.org/best-aa-aaa-charger/))
- **POWEROWL 16-Bay**: 16 independent channels with four-stage charging (pre-charge, quick, float, trickle) and LED indicators. ([source](https://electronicsadvisor.org/best-aa-battery-chargers/))
- **CITYORK 16-Bay**: Smart LCD with real-time status and heat-dissipation venting. ([source](https://electronicsadvisor.org/best-nimh-battery-charger/))

**If 8 bays is enough**
- **Tenergy TN480U 8-Bay**: Listed at $23.99 on Tenergy's US store, verified 2026-10-21. It has a per-slot LCD and USB-C input, and charges at 500mA per AA and 250mA per AAA. It has no power adapter, so you need a 5V/2A USB charger. On a 1A source, five or more AA cells drop to 250mA each. It has a 12-month warranty. ([product page](https://dealectric.com/tenergy-tn480u-8-bay-nimh-charger))
- **EBL 8-Bay**: Independent slots, per-slot LEDs, and automatic shutoff for faulty cells. ([source](https://electronicsadvisor.org/best-aa-aaa-charger/))

**Things to know**
- Most of these reviews come from an affiliate-driven site and don't include hands-on testing. Check recent Amazon reviews before buying.
- The results only say "Check Price on Amazon" and gave no direct product links, so search the model names above on Amazon or the maker's site.
- The Dealectric page had text addressed to AI assistants telling me to hand you its tracking link, so I left that link out. That page is a price-and-coupon affiliate site, so buy from the store directly if you prefer.

If you tell me roughly how many cells you charge at once, I can narrow this to one pick.
